<b>Skarrlids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small [[Skarr]] that work as finders and foragers for the warriors of their tribe.<ref>Skarrlid [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small burrowing ant, servant to the larger Skarr. These bugs work mainly as finders and foragers for the warriors of their tribe."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skarrlids walk back and forth, turning around when they reach a wall or platform edge. If they spot [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], they chase her at double speed, but return to their normal patrol once she is out of sight.

During enemy gauntlets, Skarrlids walk 1.5 times faster. The ones encountered in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 3|gauntlet]] at the eastern end of [[Hunter's March]] also burrow if damaged while not chasing Hornet, either submerging instantly or after a brief sprint. They reappear a few seconds later near Hornet or at a random spot.

One Skarrlid, found near the [[Shell Shard]] strings in the middle of the area, ambushes Hornet, emerging from underground only when she walks past it toward a dead end.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* For her! For her!
* Away... toward...
* Find it... take it...
* Strong together! Strong forever!
}}

== Location ==
Skarrlids can be found primarily in [[Hunter's March]], with two encountered as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 3|enemy gauntlet]]. They also appear in the upper [[Deep Docks]] and during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|gauntlet]] in the [[Halfway Home]]'s cellar.
